item.title: The untold history behind Thanksgiving
item.description: The Thanksgiving story is often told as a simple tale of friendship between the Pilgrims and Native Americans, but the reality is more complicated. Host Megan McArdle is joined by author Charles Mann to explore the history behind the holiday and the complex relationships that followed. They discuss how the groups meeting brought the exchange of ideas, commerce and technology, but also violence, resentment and displacement.
